title.narrative: Restored irrigation area in communities with rehabilitated tertiary network (this is a new indicator for a new component 2).

comment.narrative: Because of deteriorated state of tertiary system and high water losses in selected communities come number of hectares was notcultivated. With rehabilitation of tertiary canals, more water will become available and consequently more land will be cultivated.

Given that most of rehabilitation activities have been completed ans some are still underway, we do expect some increase inirrigation area during 2013 agricultural season, which could be validated at the end of the season.

title.narrative: Restored irrigation area in communities with rehabilitated tertiary network (this is a new indicator for a new component 2).

comment.narrative: Because of deteriorated state of tertiary system and high water losses in selected communities come number of hectares was notcultivated. With rehabilitation of tertiary canals, more water will become available and consequently more land will be cultivated.

Under AF overall potential increase in agricultural area due to saved water in tertiary canals would be about 1,760 ha. However,only 20% of potential increase may occur each year due to associated investment costs. Therefore, by end-Project two agriculturalseasons only about 40% (704 ha) may be brought back to irrigation
Given that rehabilitation activities are underway, we do not expect any increase in irrigation area during 2012.

title.narrative: Reduction of water losses in the selected primary irrigation schemes.

comment.narrative: For main canal this level of losses is considered high. This indicator includes both water losses in main canals as well as intertiaries, rehabilitation of which was included under the AF as a new component.

Target achieved. This indicator relates to the 1st component of the project, which is rehabilitation of main canals. Given thatabout 147.5 km of selected canals sections have been rehabilitated, it was estimated that water losses were reduced from 23% to6-7%. In volumetric terms the water losses were reduced from 114 MCM to 17 MCM under the original Project and from 40 MCM to 6 MCMunder AF.

title.narrative: Reduction of water losses on the primary sections of Armavir and Talin#s schemes

comment.narrative: For main canal this level of losses is considered high.

Under original project 62% of the total lengths of the two canals were rehabilitated and consequently the losses were reduced from114 MCM to 17.1 MCM. Under AF it is planned to rehabilitate less than 17% of the total length of the canals in the selectedschemes,consequently, water losses will be reduced from 40 MCM to about 6 MCM.

Given that about 70.1 km of the envisaged 99.9 km (revised from the initially planned 113 km) long sections of selected canalswererehabilitated, it was estimated that water losses are reduced on average by about 12% (from 23% to 11%). While for the originalproject, under which 89.5 km were rehabilitated, the water losses were reduced by 17%, going down from 23% to 6-7%.

title.narrative: Number of permanent agricultural jobs created

comment.narrative: The project will be tracking new agricultural jobs created as a result of project activities.

The target number is estimated based on anticipated irrigation area increase and the existing cropping and land ownershippatterns.The eventual target is 4,200 jobs, which may be achieved in 4-5 year after project closing when more land will return toirrigation and higher value crops replace current mostly low value crops.

During 2012 agricultural season the number of permanent agricultural jobs was estimated to be around 1600. This information thePIUobtained through the GIS system installed in WUAs offices. The new information may become available only after the 2013irrigation /agricultural season.
